description.en:
Gives the ball to a player. The ball is moved to the player's position, and the player becomes the holder for the given team. The story matches call it right after a scripted scene, so play resumes with the ball where the scene left it.
The player can be given by parameter ID (searched among that team's players, bench included) or by a position offset among that team's players on the pitch.
The optional third argument sets a flag in the ball's state; its effect was not identified (it is used once, in btl0004.nut).
It also resets some of the ball's state (its movement values).
Team that gets the ball: 0 = the player's team, 1 = the opponent team.
Parameter ID (e.g. "para_cp0008") or position offset among the team's players on the pitch (e.g. 0 or 9).
Stored in a bit of the ball's state; effect not identified.

true once the ball is given.
false when a position offset matches no player (nothing happens). With a parameter ID it returns true even if the team has no player with that ID.
null if the script system is not ready or fewer than 2 arguments are given.

examples.case: Handing the ball to the opponent's ace after a scene (real usage, from btl0016.nut)
By position offset (real usage, from btl0032.nut)
